verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a first-party AI Toolkit skill/plugin (e.g. `claude plugin install shopify-ai-toolkit@claude-plugins-official`). With it, users ask their assistant in natural language ("find me crewneck sweaters under $50") and the skill picks the right UCP CLI command across catalog, cart, checkout and order operations. Probes confirm the underlying CLI and MCP surfaces are live. missing for 10: hands-on evidence of the natural-language skill path itself (probes exercised only raw CLI/JSON-RPC), detailed docs on natural-language coverage beyond a single example, and independent corroboration; the natural-language layer also depends on a third-party assistant host.
